# Octaloop

> Octaloop is an India-based marketing agency for B2B tech and SaaS, fintech, AI and Web3 brands: AEO (answer engine optimisation), PR, paid ads and events. Octaloop also runs India Blockchain Tour and Metamorphosis.

## Services
- [AEO](https://octaloop.com/aeo/): Getting brands named and cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews.
- [Pricing](https://octaloop.com/pricing/): All prices in USD: free AI-visibility snapshot, $750 audit, $3,000 pilot, retainers from $3,500/mo, PR from $400 per placement.
- [PR](https://octaloop.com/pr/): Earned media for tech brands: bylines, features and roundup placements.
- [Events](https://octaloop.com/events/): India Blockchain Tour (26 City Stops since 2016) and Metamorphosis, India's Premier Web3 x AI Gala.
- [Past events](https://octaloop.com/past-events/)
- [Contact](https://octaloop.com/contact-us/)

## Guides
- [Should You Hire an AEO Agency? DIY vs Agency Costs (2026)](https://octaloop.com/blog/should-you-hire-an-aeo-agency/): An honest guide to hiring an AEO agency in 2026: what you can do yourself, published agency, freelancer and tool prices, 10 questions to ask any AEO agency, and red flags.
- [Startup PR on a Budget: How B2B SaaS Founders Get Press (2026)](https://octaloop.com/blog/startup-pr-b2b-saas-on-a-budget/): How B2B SaaS founders get press without a $10k/month agency: what counts as news, a DIY pitching workflow based on 2026 journalist surveys, and DIY vs freelancer vs agency costs.
- [How to Revive a Dead Slack or WhatsApp Community (2026)](https://octaloop.com/blog/revive-dead-online-community/): A step-by-step plan to revive a quiet Slack or WhatsApp community without spamming members: diagnose, reset, add rituals, meet in person, measure.
- [How Long Does AEO Take? Realistic Timelines by Engine (2026)](https://octaloop.com/blog/how-long-does-aeo-take/): How long AEO takes to work, from 2026 studies: first AI citations in days to weeks, steady visibility in about 3 months. Timelines by engine and 90-day milestones.
- [Founder-Led Marketing on LinkedIn for B2B SaaS: 2026 Data and Playbook](https://octaloop.com/blog/founder-led-marketing-linkedin-b2b/): Does founder-led marketing on LinkedIn work for B2B SaaS? 2026 benchmarks on reach, cadence and formats, five post types that work, and how to turn posts into pipeline and AI citations.
- [How to Run Meetups People Keep Coming Back To (2026)](https://octaloop.com/blog/how-to-organize-meetups-build-community/): How to turn one meetup into a series: a founder's playbook for organizing tech meetups, cutting no-shows, and building a community that lasts.
- [Why ChatGPT Describes Your Startup Wrong (and How to Fix It)](https://octaloop.com/blog/chatgpt-wrong-information-about-company/): ChatGPT has wrong or outdated facts about your company? 2026 data on what AI gets wrong about B2B brands, where the errors come from, and a step-by-step fix list.
- [B2B SaaS Marketing Channels That Work in 2026](https://octaloop.com/blog/b2b-saas-marketing-channels-2026/): 2026 buyer and marketer data on which B2B channels work, plus a stage-by-stage channel map for SaaS founders.
- [Events for AEO: How Conference Talks Get You Cited by AI](https://octaloop.com/blog/events-conferences-aeo/): Which event assets (YouTube sessions, speaker pages, LinkedIn, podcasts, recaps) AI engines cite, and how to turn one talk into citable assets.
- [Metamorphosis'26 Recap: India's Web3 x AI Summit in Hyderabad](https://octaloop.com/blog/metamorphosis-2026-hyderabad-recap/): T-Hub, 26–27 Sep 2026: speakers, partners, themes and what five editions taught us about growing a tech event.
- [Digital PR for AEO: How Earned Media Gets You Cited by AI](https://octaloop.com/blog/digital-pr-for-aeo/): Which publications AI engines cite, and a step-by-step digital PR plan for B2B SaaS.
- [AEO vs GEO vs SEO: What a B2B SaaS Founder Actually Needs to Know](https://octaloop.com/blog/aeo-vs-geo-vs-seo/): Definitions, comparison table and which to prioritise by stage.
- [How to Get Your SaaS Mentioned in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews](https://octaloop.com/blog/get-saas-mentioned-in-chatgpt-perplexity-ai-overviews/): The Octaloop Citation Loop: baseline, extractable pages, earned mentions, entity accuracy, re-measure.
